# fabric_plans (Data Source)

The Plans data-source allows you to retrieve a list of Fabric [Plans](https://learn.microsoft.com/fabric/iq/plan/overview).

-> This data-source supports Service Principal authentication.

~> This data-source is in **preview**. To access it, you must explicitly enable the `preview` mode in the provider level configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get all items in workspace
data "fabric_plans" "example" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The Workspace ID.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `values` (Attributes Set) The set of Plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>

### Nested Schema for `values`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The Plan description.
- `display_name` (String) The Plan display name.
- `folder_id` (String) The Plan Folder ID.
- `id` (String) The Plan ID.
- `tags` (Set of String) A set of tag IDs assigned to the Plan.
- `workspace_id` (String) The Workspace ID.
